spec.name: Volubilis International Festival of Traditional World Music
spec.description: International festival of traditional world music staged in the Roman archaeological site of Volubilis, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and in the squares of Meknes. It hosts musical cultures from around the world in a dialogue of civilizations.

editions.notes: Held at Volubilis and Place Lahdim, Meknes
